Access common and format-specific extraction metadata

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "xberg"
result = Xberg.extract(Xberg::ExtractInput.new(kind: 'uri', mime_type: 'text/html', uri: 'https://example.com/html/simple_table.html'), {  })
puts result.results[0].metadata.inspect
puts result.results[0].metadata.format.html.title.inspect
```
